d: Straight, dark navy blue hair with long bangs is partially hidden under a hood, adorned with a large, dark blue and black butterfly-shaped accessory. The eyes are a glowing magenta shade with a wide, peering expression, set on a youthful face with a slender build. The attire consists of a voluminous, oversized purple hooded cloak that is pulled up over the head and clutched close to the face.
